h: Israel’s Salvation Brings Joy as the Shechinah Returns

p: "And gladden our soul with Your salvation":
for we request the salvations of Hashem,
"And Hashem your God will return with your captivity,"
"It does not say 'He will bring back,'
the Shechinah, as it were, is with them,
"For your sake I was sent to Bavel."
"and gladden our soul with Your salvation."
And this is "for You are with me":
and it arose in thought before You,
the corruption and the teshuvah and the redemption;
that the sufferings are the preparation for salvation
HaKadosh Baruch Hu gave to Yisrael,
And through the sufferings of Egypt
and through the sufferings of the wilderness,
"and He afflicted you and let you hunger" (Devarim 8:3),
וּלְעוֹלָם הַבָּא גַּם כֵּן כְּתִיב (מִשְׁלֵי ו, כג)
And of the World to Come too it is written (Mishlei 6:23):
"And the way of life is the rebukes of discipline";
one merits the World to Come.
And this is "Your rod and Your staff,
that the sufferings are preparation for eternal life;
to the Resurrection of the Dead
"and each man with his staff in his hand" (Zechariah 8:4).
And in this parshah teshuvah is not mentioned;
and the Ramban, of blessed memory, wrote
שֶׁכָּאן הוּא עַל פִּי דַּעַת רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ
that here it follows the view of Rabbi Yehoshua
"and not with money will you be redeemed" (Yeshayahu 52:3).
since it was alluded to before,
presumably Yisrael will be in teshuvah.
And therefore this parshah is called a song,
for He made known to Yisrael
that such would be the order,
and that it would be known beforehand:
and afterward they would be saved
"and gladden our soul with Your salvation."

paragraphs.text: Source: Zechariah 9:9 — “גילי מאד בת ציון הריעי בת ירושל͏ם הנה מלכך יבוא לך צדיק ונושע הוא עני ורכב על חמור ועל עיר בן אתנות” — “Rejoice greatly, Fair Zion; Raise a shout, Fair Jerusalem!
